design.hebrewCalendarHint: Show calendar months in the Hebrew calendar (Tishrei, Nisan…), with dates in Hebrew letter-numerals.
design.hebrewCalendarDualHint: Dual view — each day also shows its Gregorian date.
design.hebrewDateInputHint: Pick dates by the Hebrew calendar everywhere in the app. The date itself is stored normally.
design.previewCardBody: A sample card — it changes with every choice here, so you never have to guess.
design.rtlHint: A full change of text direction takes effect after a restart.

questions.empty: No daily questions yet. Add your first one.
questions.reminderLabel: Remind me to answer if I haven't by
questions.reminderHint: If you haven't answered by the time you pick, a gentle reminder appears in the "How are you today" widget on your home screen.

data.intro: An overview of your data, plus import and export from a CSV / Excel file.
data.exportHint: One place for every export: everything together in an Excel file (a sheet per type), or a single export of transactions / clients / projects to CSV.
data.importHint: Supports CSV, TSV and Excel — several files and sheets at once are fine. It auto-detects columns (name, phone, email, project, amount, date and more), lets you map them by hand, and review everything before anything is saved.
data.importUnsupported: Couldn't read the file — that format isn't supported. You can import CSV or Excel (xlsx/xls); a Numbers or Google Sheets file can be exported to CSV.
data.importFailed: Couldn't read the file — make sure it's a valid CSV or Excel file and isn't currently open in another program.
data.importNone: No new records were created (they may already exist).
data.importEstNote_one: 1 of them with an estimated date — you can edit it on the money screen.
data.importEstNote_other: {{count}} of them with an estimated date — you can edit them on the money screen.
data.restartHint: Reopens the setup wizard from the first step. Handy if you skipped partway through.

danger.resetAction: Delete all data and start over
danger.resetHint: Deletes all the data in your account (clients, projects, leads, transactions, goals, reminders and more) and restarts the intro. This needs double confirmation and can't be undone.
danger.deleteHint: Deletes the whole account — including the login itself — not just the data. There's a 30-day grace period to change your mind and cancel; after that everything is permanently deleted and you can't sign in again. Requires typed double confirmation.
danger.restartMessage: Restart the intro? The steps reset to the beginning — data you've already created (clients, projects, etc.) stays put.
danger.intro: Two actions that cannot be undone. Both ask again after you press.
danger.resetConfirmAgain: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
